1606976151439933441.a: Too many people seem lost as to how time works in our small part of the universe. For example, if you learn something today that knowledge does not invalidate your caution a year ago. Your magic solution today did not, and can never, help anyone a year ago. Not even Zurvan. ⏳🤷🏼‍♂️

1607073736007766016.a: It's deeply concerning realizing how many people equate planning for tomorrow with worrying. That's some deep trauma that needs addressed. Thinking, "I need to fix that before it burns down the house." is planning not worrying. Worrying is "The thems are coming to gets us!"
